integrity_notes: This theorem concerns the ordinary geometric quotient, not a Borel quotient.

Barmak previously determined the unquotiented sphere wedge; separate indexed mathematical records determined integral permutation-homology lattices and rational quotient Betti ranks. Those results are excluded from the novelty claim.
All-width proof is written in the package; finite code corroborates the direct cell count and relator-exponent statements, not the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved for n>=5 with gcd(n,6)=1 only; widths divisible by two or three are excluded because orbit stabilizers arise.
No extra equivariant decomposition asserted after taking the cyclic quotient; no extension to larger underlying Kneser subset sizes.
An unindexed previously published equivalent calculation remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Cyclic quotients of two-subset Kneser independence complexes are Moore-space wedges
